question.nlq: I would like to list the top three companies by financial performance, and for each of those companies, show the name of the building in which they first established an office location.
evidence: Financial performance is defined as the total profit in billions, using the column Profits_billion.
Financial performance is defined as the profit margin, calculated as Profits_billion divided by Sales_billion.

meanings.hidden_knowledge: Use the definition of financial performance that relies on the total profit in billions (Profits_billion).
meanings.gt_sql:
WITH top_companies AS (
    SELECT id, name, Profits_billion
    FROM Companies
    ORDER BY Profits_billion DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
first_office AS (
    SELECT company_id, MIN(move_in_year) AS first_year
    FROM Office_locations
    GROUP BY company_id
)
SELECT tc.name AS company_name,
       b.name AS building_name
FROM top_companies tc
JOIN first_office fo ON tc.id = fo.company_id
JOIN Office_locations ol ON ol.company_id = fo.company_id AND ol.move_in_year = fo.first_year
JOIN buildings b ON b.id = ol.building_id
ORDER BY tc.Profits_billion DESC;

meanings.hidden_knowledge: Use the definition of financial performance that relies on the profit margin (Profits_billion divided by Sales_billion).
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT b.name
FROM (
    SELECT id, (Profits_billion / Sales_billion) AS profit_margin
    FROM Companies
    ORDER BY profit_margin DESC
    LIMIT 3
) AS topc
JOIN Office_locations ol
    ON ol.company_id = topc.id
    AND ol.move_in_year = (
        SELECT MIN(move_in_year)
        FROM Office_locations
        WHERE company_id = topc.id
    )
JOIN buildings b
    ON b.id = ol.building_id
ORDER BY topc.profit_margin DESC;
